Company Description
Egis is a leading global organisation in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services. We partner with clients to design, deliver and operate smarter infrastructure and places that respond to the world’s evolving needs.
With more than 22,000 employees worldwide, we combine global capability with strong local insight. Our multidisciplinary expertise enables us to deliver innovative, practical and sustainable solutions that help build more balanced, resilient communities.
At Egis, you’ll be part of a business shaping the future of cities, transport, energy and the built environment, creating lasting impact where it matters most.
Job Description
Step into a role where your ideas and curiosity genuinely matter. As a Graduate Consultant, you’ll contribute to real projects from your first week.
You’ll support rail and rolling stock pr
key_lines: Step into a role where your ideas and curiosity genuinely matter. As a Graduate Consultant, you’ll contribute to real projects from your first week.

You’ll support rail and rolling stock projects across Australia for a range of clients, as well as contribute to developing our business through tenders and other engagements. Join our dynamic and high-performing Rail team for the 2027 Graduate intake!
Hands-on Industry Experience: work in an area where many specialties intersect and problem solve to create unique solutions.
Collaboration: as your career develops, work closely with experts across civil, mechanical, mechatronic and electrical engineering.
Qualifications
- Tertiary degree in Civil, Mechanical or Mechatronic Engineering
- Relevant internship, vacation, or industry experience is highly valued
TO APPLY
We believe our strong graduate program will provide you with the tools you need to start your career the right way.
If this sounds like the opportunity for you APPLY NOW!

candidates.title: Graduate Engineer, Urban Infrastructure
candidates.opening:
Play a critical role in the built environment by uplifting lives, creating regenerative environments and advancing industries
Work in a truly flexible environment with an incredibly supportive team
Environment where collaboration and innovation are encouraged 
Create futures worth inheriting with SMEC and the SJ Group 
About SMEC 
SMEC provides unique opportunities to work on iconic industry projects with experienced colleagues and leadership teams. We support and empower employees to drive innovation initiatives within a well-established and growing organisation.
With over 16,500 employees working out of 120 offices in 40+ countries throughout Australasia, Asia, the Middle East, UK, Africa, North and South America, we partner with our parent company Surbana Jurong and sister company Robert Bird Group (RBG) to deliver integrated Infrastructure, Urban Development and Management Servic
key_lines: SMEC provides unique opportunities to work on iconic industry projects with experienced colleagues and leadership teams. We support and empower employees to drive innovation initiatives within a well-established and growing organisation.
Graduate

As a Graduate at SMEC, you’ll be part of a high-impact talent group, contributing to the delivery of major rail and metro infrastructure projects alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists.

Our two-year Graduate Development Program (GDP) is designed to accelerate your growth — combining hands-on project experience with structured learning, mentoring, and exposure across teams and disciplines.
A connected ANZ graduate network and strong peer community
Structured development through workshops, online learning, and immersive experiences

You’ll support the delivery of real infrastructure projects from day one — contributing to design, analysis and documentation while learning from experienced engineers and gaining exposure to site and project delivery.
Learn and apply industry standards, tools and best practice through structured development and on-the-job experience
You’re a motivated Civil Engineering graduate who enjoys problem-solving, working in teams, and contributing to real-world projects.
A degree in Civil Engineering (or related discipline)
Exposure to design tools such as AutoCAD or Civil 3D (12D or similar advantageous)
How To Apply
To apply, click on the "Apply Now" link and follow the prompts. Please include a copy of your CV and academic transcript.
